selection_rule: tied-score ROC, floor(0.01*Nneg) FP budget; eligible detection >= .99 then minimum negative weak evaluations, higher detection, fewer weak; otherwise higher detection, lower negative evaluations, fewer weak; A/B/C then grid order
empty_arrivals: No calibration faces: threshold -1e30 (retain all); zero calibration negatives: pass target satisfied. Zero fitting negatives: append deterministic zero-alpha stumps if required for frozen/minimum architecture; no weight fitting possible.
